claims.evidence: The witness report describes a blue console with gold symbols and a PlayStation logo, matching the 'Days of Play' Slim edition.
The witness report explicitly states games are not shown; additionally, PES 2027 is not a released or existing title.
The condition of the warranty seals is not mentioned in the witness report.

claims.claim: No overheating and all ports working
claims.evidence: Functional testing of internal temperature and port connectivity cannot be confirmed via photos.
The witness only saw one camouflage controller, whereas 'pads' implies multiple units.
The receipt was not shown in the witness report.

risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'System Storage' menu in the console settings.
A video showing the console successfully logging into the PlayStation Network.
A video showing a game disc being inserted, read, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a digital-only unit with a broken drive.

risks.proof: Clear photos of the console surface with the plastic film removed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having heavy scratches or surface wear.

risks.proof: A close-up photo of the factory warranty seals on the back of the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a previously opened or repaired unit.

proof_requests: Screenshot of the System Storage settings.
Photo of the warranty seals on the rear of the console.
Video of the console connecting to the internet and PSN.
Video of a disc being played.
Photos of the console without the plastic wrap.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
response.reason: The witness confirms the physical existence of a PlayStation console matching the 'Days of Play' Slim edition. Due to the impossible claim of 'PES 2027', the software value is ignored and the item is priced as a base 500GB hardware unit with one controller.
